agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every generated narrative timestamp must be measured at artifact creation or copied from an authoritative typed evidence time.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The generated report used a guessed static 04:15 Brisbane timestamp that was still in the future when the attempt and readback completed.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The report timestamp was compared with the machine clock and the evidence launch time during immediate postexecution readback.

correction.action: Preserve the report bytes, reject only the timestamp metadata, retain the typed launch time as authoritative and add an evidence regression test.
correction.prevention_control: Generated narrative timestamps come from the creation clock or an already typed evidence timestamp; guessed static future values are forbidden.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records and corrects the generated report's guessed future timestamp without changing the accepted typed diagnostic evidence.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Transactional node contract_evidence is empty unless it contains the graph's structured contract-evidence objects; ordinary artifact paths belong in the evidence inventory.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first prospective intent placed three ordinary file-path strings in contract_evidence and the clockwork rejected the graph projection before commands or publication.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The clockwork validated the prospective Continuity and Compass graph and returned contract_evidence_object_required while every canonical byte remained unchanged.

correction.action: Keep the exact contract and schema paths in the node artifact inventory and make contract_evidence empty because no structured contract-evidence object is needed.
correction.prevention_control: Ordinary file paths are routed through evidence.artifacts; contract_evidence is reserved for schema-valid structured graph objects.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected contract-evidence string shape and correct artifact-inventory routing.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The prospective register revision increments once per accepted clockwork transaction, while incident population and incident identifiers increment independently for every observation in that transaction.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The second prospective intent incorrectly incremented the register revision once for each of two observations and named revision 603 instead of canonical revision 601 plus one transaction, revision 602.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The clockwork compared the prospective note with the canonical register and rejected tick_incident_revision_path before commands or publication.

correction.action: Use prospective register revision 602, incident population 870 and latest incident AER-0870 for this one transaction containing three observations.
correction.prevention_control: Derive the register revision as canonical revision plus one per transaction; derive incident population and identifiers independently from the observation count.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected per-observation revision increment and restores the clockwork's one-revision-per-transaction reading.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A deterministic check executed through the provider-free test wrapper supplies every required local resource path explicitly and does not rely on stripped ambient user-location variables.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first combined focused/evidence run called deterministic_check without cache_root; the provider-free wrapper had correctly removed LOCALAPPDATA, so the test failed before any native process was created.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The focused provider-free test gate failed with the typed localappdata_missing guard error while native-process count remained zero.

correction.action: Keep the hash-bound focused test unchanged and run it through the closeout's no-conftest pytest command, which retains the accepted host cache-location binding without loading repository conftest.
correction.prevention_control: Provider-free wrapper suitability is checked against each test's bound local-resource requirements before command-manifest selection; postexecution implementation bytes remain immutable.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the stripped cache-location input and corrects the mutable verifier invocation while preserving the accepted execution source unchanged.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The focused test bound by implementation_bytes remains byte-identical after the native attempt; closeout-only execution-environment corrections occur in the mutable command manifest.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first cache-root correction edited the hash-bound focused test, so the next run correctly failed with implementation_digest_mismatch before any native process was created.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The accepted deterministic source recalculated implementation_bytes and rejected the changed focused-test digest.

correction.action: Restore the focused test byte-for-byte and move the environment-sensitive verification choice to the closeout command manifest's no-conftest pytest invocation.
correction.prevention_control: After occupied execution, implementation_bytes paths are immutable; closeout verification adaptations are expressed only in unbound verifier orchestration.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records and reverses the hash-bound focused-test edit, moving the correction to mutable closeout orchestration.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every incident observation chooses category directly from EXPECTED_ORIGIN_BY_CATEGORY's closed vocabulary.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The third prospective clockwork intent used the descriptive categories test_setup_error and protected_evidence_boundary_violation, neither of which belongs to the closed incident vocabulary.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The clockwork rejected tick_incident_category before commands or canonical publication; direct reading of EXPECTED_ORIGIN_BY_CATEGORY identified operator_error as the admitted category for both observations.

correction.action: Replace both descriptive categories with the admitted operator_error category and bind future selection to the runtime category map.
correction.prevention_control: Incident category is selected by reading EXPECTED_ORIGIN_BY_CATEGORY; free-form category authoring is forbidden.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records and corrects the two descriptive incident categories by selecting the admitted operator_error coordinate.
